THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: MUL/LND/02/ACQ/41. Land Ministry No.:4-3$15$2014$VE$282. I, hereby given notice under Sub Section (1) of Section 07 of the land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following Land/ servitude* which is required public purpose:- Description of the land or servitude to be Acquired: Under mentioned allotments of land shown in the Surveyor General’s No. F.V.P. 166, Supplement No. 33, sheet No. 35, situated in the village of Pallewela, Batadola Grama Niladari Division, Mulatiyana Divisional Secretary’s Division in the Matara district, Southern Province. 01. Lot No. 745 Name of the Land: Puwakgahahena; Description: Garden, 40 Rubber trees, (about 5-10 years of age) 01 Cocount tree (about 20 years of age) Tree Arecaunt trees (about 1-15 years of age) Four Jack trees (about 40-50 years of age); Claimant: G.A. Karunarathna, No. 222, Denagama East Galwawegedara; Extent: 0.0300 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 746 Name of the Land: Panikolahena; Description: Garden, Two Attonia trees (about 20-25 years of age) one garcinia (Goraka) tree (about 30 years of age) Six Coconut tree (about 35-45 years of age) four Jack trees (about 50-55 years of age); Claimant: G. A. Gunapala, No. 218, Kadegedara, Denagama East; Extent: 0.0172 Hectare. 03. Lot No. 747 Name of the Land: Panikolahena; Description: Garden, one arecaunt tree (about 15 years of age), two garcinia trees (Goraka) (about 30-35 years of age), Two attonia trees (about 20-25 years of age), one cashew tree (about 25-30 years of age); Claimant: Late G. A. Gimarahami Lidagawadeniya Denagama Hakmana; Extent: 0.0185 Hectare. 04. Lot No. 748 Name of the Land: Panikolahena; Description: Garden, Five Coconut trees (about 35-40 years of age), Three garcinia (Goraka) trees (about 40-45 years of age), Two Aricanut trees (about 10-20 years of age) One Mango tree (about 25-30 years of age), One Welan tree and One Breadfruit tree (about 20-30 years of age); Claimant: G. A. Ariyapala 51C, Malimbadagewatta, Hiththatiya, Matara; Extent: 0.0381 Hectare.

A. Dayasena Welipitiyegadara, Denagama East and P. A. Padmalatha Allawelagedara, Denagama West; Extent: 0.00151 Hectare. 07. Lot No. 751 Name of the Land: Panikolahena; Description: Garden, Tree Coconut trees (about 50-55 years of age), two Jack trees (about 40-45 years of age), five arecanut trees (about 10-15 years of age), Two Garcinia (Goraka) trees (about 20-25 years of age), One Rain tree (about 20 years of age) and a mango tree; Claimant: Late M. A. Pemanis, Bogahakoratuwa, Denagama; Extent: 0.0163 Hectare. 08. Lot No. 752 Name of the Land: Puwakgahahena; Description: Garden, One Coconut tree (about 40 years of age), One Bread Fruit tree (about 20 years of age), One Arecanut

tree (about 5-10 years of age); Claimant: Ranaweerage Jothipala, No. 235, Panikolahena, Denagama; Extent: 0.0033 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid lands/ on which a servitude is to be acquired, are hereby required to appear personally, or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Mulatiyana on the 31 day of October 2018 at 1.00 p.m and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 26 day of October 2018 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land / servitude* the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. SUSANTHA ATHTHANAYAKA, Divisional Secretary , Mulatiyana. Divisional Secretariat, Mulatiyana. 16th August, 2018. 09-89
